product_name: Fishbowl (Fishbowl Inventory and Fishbowl Manufacturing; cloud editions branded Fishbowl Drive / Fishbowl Advanced)
target_vertical: Manufacturers, wholesalers/distributors, and multi-channel retailers, especially QuickBooks-using businesses in the US
pricing_model: Tiered subscription (per user, monthly or annual) for Fishbowl Drive/Advanced cloud SKUs, plus legacy perpetual-license model for on-premise Fishbowl Manufacturing/Warehouse; mandatory paid implementation package on top
starting_price_usd: Approximately $329/month for entry-tier cloud (Fishbowl Drive) per public listings; legacy perpetual single-user license historically quoted around $4,395 one-time. Vendor no longer publishes a single transparent starting price; quotes are custom. [uncertain]
free_trial_or_freemium: 14-day free trial of Fishbowl software; no permanent freemium tier. Free demo on request.
shopify_supported: Native (first-party Fishbowl-built integrations exist for both Fishbowl Drive/Online and Fishbowl Advanced, plus the Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware multi-channel hub)
shopify_app_listing_url: https://apps.shopify.com/fishbowl-online-1 (Fishbowl Drive / Fishbowl Online); secondary listing https://apps.shopify.com/app50104 (Fishbowl Sellware Marketplace)
shopify_app_rating: 5.0 out of 5 (Fishbowl Drive listing, as reported in Shopify App Store summaries)
shopify_install_count: Approx. 89 reviews on the Fishbowl Drive listing (install count not publicly disclosed by Shopify)
shopify_built_for_shopify_badge: Yes — Fishbowl Drive listing is reported as carrying the Built for Shopify badge
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional overall: orders flow Shopify -> Fishbowl, inventory quantities and (for Advanced) product/SKU data flow Fishbowl -> Shopify; tracking numbers/fulfillments push back to Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products/SKUs, inventory quantities, sales orders (incl. customer, salesperson, carrier, payment terms, tax rate), fulfillments/tracking numbers, customers. Refunds, draft orders, and metafield-level mapping are not documented as natively supported. [uncertain] for refunds and draft orders
shopify_service_item_support: Not documented as a native feature; Fishbowl is part-centric and treats non-physical items as generic parts. [uncertain]
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware hub is designed to manage multiple Shopify (and other) stores under one Fishbowl tenant
shopify_pos_support: No native Shopify POS integration documented; Fishbowl ships its own POS/Checkout module separate from Shopify POS. [uncertain]
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: No documented native handling of Shopify B2B catalogs, price lists, or company locations (Plus B2B). [uncertain]
shopify_markets_support: No documented native support for Shopify Markets multi-market pricing, duties, or landed cost. [uncertain]
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: No documented generic metafield <-> Fishbowl custom field mapping UI
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variants/options map via shared SKU; products and variants are matched by SKU between Fishbowl and Shopify
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Scheduled / batched sync (configurable import/export schedule) for the legacy Fishbowl Advanced plugin; Fishbowl Drive cloud edition is closer to near-real-time but specific webhook driven event coverage is not publicly documented. [uncertain]
shopify_known_limitations: Community-reported issues: integration described as clunky in some configurations; difficulty pulling Shopify location-level inventory or shipping quotes pre-sync; on-premise edition requires periodic polling rather than webhooks; refunds/returns handling and B2B/Markets not deeply supported; dated UX often cited; some users had to use third-party connectors (Sellware, Spark Shipping, Extensiv, Mitash, HulkApps) to bridge gaps.
etsy_supported: Third-party only (no first-party Etsy connector documented; Etsy is reached via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware or external connectors like Spark Shipping/Flxpoint)
etsy_inventory_sync: Inventory sync available via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware multi-channel routing; exact frequency depends on connector. [uncertain]
etsy_order_import: Orders imported via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware on a scheduled basis. [uncertain]
etsy_synced_entities: Listings, inventory, orders (via Sellware/third-party). Variations, personalization, digital products, and receipts handling not documented. [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: No first-party Etsy integration; reliant on Sellware or third-party connectors, which limits depth on Etsy-specific concepts like variations and personalization. [uncertain]
amazon_supported: Native — Fishbowl ships an Amazon integration in Fishbowl Advanced and via Fishbowl Commerce (Sellware)
amazon_marketplaces: Multiple Amazon marketplaces supported via SP-API; US, UK, EU, CA, AU, MX commonly cited but full marketplace coverage not publicly enumerated. [uncertain]
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM both supported. Vendor Central support not documented. [uncertain] for Vendor Central
amazon_synced_entities: Listings/products, inventory quantities, sales orders, fulfillments (including FBA orders), tracking. Settlements, returns, and messaging not documented as natively synced. [uncertain] for settlements/returns/messaging
amazon_listing_creation: Sync of existing listings is the documented primary use; native listing creation from Fishbowl is limited and often handled via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware. [uncertain]
amazon_repricing_support: Not a native feature; relies on third-party repricers. [uncertain]
amazon_buy_shipping: No documented in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase; shipping is handled via ShipStation/ShipExpress and direct UPS/FedEx ODBC. [uncertain]
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA outbound order processing is supported; a dedicated FBA inbound shipment creation workflow inside Fishbowl is not publicly documented. [uncertain]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Not documented as a native feature in Fishbowl; settlement/marketplace tax reconciliation typically handled in the accounting system (QuickBooks/Xero) or via add-ons such as A2X. [uncertain]
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Not natively handled by Fishbowl as a marketplace-facilitator-aware journal; relies on accounting system or third-party tooling. [uncertain]
amazon_multi_account_support: Multiple Amazon seller accounts can be managed, particularly via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware. [uncertain] for exact per-tenant limits
amazon_known_limitations: Reliance on Sellware/Fishbowl Commerce for richer multi-channel features; settlement and marketplace-facilitator tax not natively reconciled; documented as scheduled/batched rather than webhook-driven for the on-premise edition.
xero_supported: Native — Fishbowl ships a first-party Xero integration (US listing on Xero App Store as 'Fishbowl Manufacturing and Warehouse')
xero_app_store_certified: Listed on the Xero App Store
xero_synced_entities: Invoices, bills, payments, contacts (customers and vendors), COGS journals, inventory adjustments, tax. Credit notes not explicitly documented. [uncertain] for credit notes
xero_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order (Fishbowl posts a Xero invoice for each customer shipment, plus the corresponding COGS and inventory entries); not a summary-journal/A2X-style poster.
xero_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement — COGS, inventory, income, tax journals are posted as shipments/receipts occur in Fishbowl, with landed cost rolled into part cost.
xero_multi_currency: Multi-currency POs and SOs are supported in Fishbowl; multi-currency posting to Xero is supported when both systems have multi-currency enabled. [uncertain] for edge cases
xero_tracking_category_mapping: Yes — Fishbowl 'Classes' can be mapped to Xero Tracking Categories so transactions allocate automatically
xero_tax_handling: Tax rates mapped from Fishbowl tax codes to Xero tax codes; GST/VAT/sales tax flows on the posted invoice/bill
xero_known_limitations: Cloud editions and on-premise editions differ in connectivity; integration is configured per-product mapping which can be operationally heavy; specific limitations around credit notes, partial refunds, and tracking category coverage on bills not fully documented. [uncertain]
qb_online_supported: Yes — QuickBooks Online (Plus and Advanced tiers) supported; Simple Start/Essentials not supported
qb_desktop_supported: Yes — tight integration with QuickBooks Desktop Pro, Premier, and Enterprise via direct integration (Fishbowl server typically co-located with the QB company file)
qb_app_certified: Listed on the Intuit App Store (QuickBooks App Store) as 'Fishbowl Inventory' and 'Fishbowl Advanced'
qb_synced_entities: Invoices, bills, payments, customers, vendors, COGS journals, inventory adjustments (cycle counts, scrap, returns), purchase orders. Credit memos not explicitly documented. [uncertain] for credit memos
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order with real-time/near-real-time posting of SOs, POs, bills, and invoices
qb_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement with landed_cost_inclusive part costing (freight/duty/fees roll into part cost at receipt)
qb_multi_currency: Supported when both Fishbowl and QuickBooks have multi-currency enabled; orders post in the alternate currency to QB.
qb_class_location_mapping: Fishbowl Classes can be mapped to QuickBooks Classes; QBO Location dimension mapping is not as deeply documented. [uncertain] for Location dimension
qb_known_limitations: QBO support limited to Plus/Advanced tiers (not Simple Start/Essentials); QB Desktop integration typically requires the Fishbowl Server and QB company file on the same OS/machine; some users report connection drops; data correction is restricted once posted; new-user complaints around clunkiness of QB sync surface frequently.
other_ecom_channels: WooCommerce, BigCommerce, eBay, Walmart, Magento — all supported, primarily via the Fishbowl Commerce / Sellware multi-channel hub; TikTok Shop, Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square not documented as first-party connectors. [uncertain] for TikTok Shop/Wix/Squarespace/Faire/Square
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — Fishbowl supports kits, BOM-driven builds, and assemblies; selling a kit/bundle decrements the component parts and vice versa.
other_accounting_integrations: Xero and QuickBooks (Online + Desktop) are the headline accounting integrations. Reckon is referenced for Australian customers. Sage 50/Intacct, MYOB, Zoho Books, FreshBooks, NetSuite, and Wave are not documented as first-party integrations. [uncertain]
multi_level_bom: Yes — multi-level/nested BOMs with sub-assemblies, multi-stage builds, multiple finished goods, complex units of measure
production_orders: Yes — Work Orders / Manufacture Orders with routings, instructions, multi-stage production, labor and job tracking, MRP, custom/batch/repair work order types
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — lot/batch tracking with expiry dates
bin_location_support: Yes — multi-warehouse with aisle/shelf/bin sub-location tracking
barcoding: Yes — barcode generation, label printing, and scanning via Fishbowl Go / Fishbowl Drive / Fishbowl Advanced Mobile apps
purchase_orders: Yes — full PO module with partial receipts, vendor price lists, reorder points, drop-ship, multi-currency POs
supplier_management: Yes — vendor records, lead times, vendor-SKU mapping, vendor part numbers, default currency per vendor; MOQ tracking is partial. [uncertain] for MOQ
landed_cost_support: Yes — freight, duty, insurance, and other fees can be allocated to part cost on PO receipt (landed cost reconciliation)
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Inventory valuation is held in the base currency; POs/SOs support alternate currencies but valuation is single base. [uncertain] for nuanced edge cases
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes — 'Fishbowl AI Insights' includes an AI Forecasting Report using historical sales, seasonal trends, lead times, and market signals (rolled out 2024-2025)
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes — Recommended Purchase Order and Part Shortage Summary AI features included in Fishbowl AI Insights
ai_natural_language_query: Yes — Fishbowl AI Insights markets natural-language access to sales, purchasing, forecasting, MRP, inventory, costing, manufacturing, BOM, and operations data (via ConverSight-powered AI). [uncertain] for depth/quality
public_api: Yes — Fishbowl Advanced exposes a REST API (GET/POST/DELETE) with API documentation; the older legacy XML/socket API is being retired. Quality is considered moderate; webhook coverage is limited compared to cloud-native competitors.
webhook_event_coverage: Limited — Fishbowl is historically poll/scheduled rather than webhook-driven; the on-premise architecture means many integrations rely on periodic checks rather than push events. [uncertain] for Fishbowl Drive cloud-only webhook events
integration_architecture: Mostly native (first-party Fishbowl-built connectors for Shopify, QuickBooks, Xero, Amazon, ShipStation, SPS Commerce, etc.); multi-channel breadth (eBay, Walmart, WooCommerce, Magento) is delivered via Fishbowl Commerce/Sellware (Fishbowl-owned). No first-party Zapier app.
zapier_make_support: No native Zapier app at time of research; some Make/n8n templates exist via community/third-party. [uncertain]
mobile_app: Yes — Fishbowl Go (legacy mobile companion), Fishbowl Drive (cloud product mobile app, iOS App Store id 1666670945), and Fishbowl Advanced Mobile (iOS and Android)
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes — barcode scanning is a core feature of all three mobile apps (Fishbowl Go, Fishbowl Drive, Fishbowl Advanced Mobile)
rate_limit_handling_documented: Not prominently documented publicly; rate-limit handling for Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO is not a marketed feature. [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Scheduled/batched (configurable, e.g. every X minutes/hours) for on-premise Fishbowl Advanced integrations to Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart; near-real-time for QuickBooks/Xero accounting posting when Fishbowl Server is online; Fishbowl Drive cloud edition skews closer to near-real-time. Exact per-integration cadence not uniformly published. [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: ShipStation (primary partner), ShipExpress (Fishbowl-branded), UPS WorldShip and FedEx Ship Manager via ODBC, StarShip, ShipWorks; USPS via partners. Direct AusPost/Royal Mail/DHL via ShipStation/StarShip. Native first-party carrier integrations are limited; most carrier access flows through ShipStation or ODBC.
shipping_label_buying: Indirectly — via ShipStation/ShipExpress/StarShip integrations rather than a native in-app label purchase
three_pl_integrations: Extensiv (formerly 3PL Central), Shipedge, and other 3PL/WMS connectors available; ShipBob, ShipHero, Deliverr not documented as first-party. [uncertain] for ShipBob/ShipHero
edi_support: Yes — first-party SPS Commerce EDI plugin (one-step EDI integration); CrossFire, ConnectPointz, and other EDI providers also supported
g2_rating: 4.0 / 5 on G2 across approximately 278 reviews (as reported in G2 listings circa 2025-2026)
capterra_rating: 4.2 / 5 on Capterra; specific review count for Fishbowl alone exceeds several hundred. Exact current review count [uncertain]
notable_customers: Customer base of 25,000+ across SMB manufacturing/wholesale; publicly cited examples include Boy Scouts of America, Mercedes-Benz (regional ops), NASA, Nike (referenced historically on vendor site). Exact current logo list [uncertain]
last_major_release: Fishbowl AI Insights (AI forecasting, recommended POs, part shortage summary, natural-language query) — rolled out 2024-2025; Fishbowl Drive cloud product continued expansion through 2025 including expanded Shopify functionality. Specific dated release notes not centrally published. [uncertain]
owner_parent_company: Diversis Capital (Los Angeles-based private equity firm) — acquired Fishbowl in December 2021
last_funding_event: Acquisition by Diversis Capital announced December 2021; no public funding rounds reported since. Fishbowl itself acquired Red Salt in 2022.
